restaurantName: Restaurant 178 at The Fairlawns Hotel and Spa
address: 178 Little Aston Road, The Fairlawns Hotel and Spa, Walsall, England,WS9 0NU
bio: Why not treat yourself to a particularly special Afternoon Tea in Restaurant 178 at Fairlawns Hotel and Spa. Boasting two AA Rosettes, an excellent long service team and beautifully understated décor, Restaurant 178 believes in homemade, seasonal produce and hearty hospitality - ideal for a special occasion, or just an afternoon of indulgence.  Enjoy a range of savoury bites including sandwiches and sausage rolls, followed by delicious warm scones, clotted cream and local jams; all topped off with a range of homemade sweet delights. Hot drinks are included but the full bar is also available for those who want to splash out.  The Fairlawns Hotel and Spa is a family run business surrounded by 12 acres of landscaped grounds; situated in Alridge, the nearest train station is Blake Street and the Number 6 bus stops right outside.  The Hotel can also cater for private Afternoon Tea parties in its Oak Room, perfect for baby showers, birthdays or anniversaries with loved ones. Please note that the room is available to hire for parties between 8-16 guests and is subject to a £75 room hire.  Afternoon Tea is served 12:30pm to 3pm Tuesday – Saturday.
pageTitle: Restaurant 178 at The Fairlawns Hotel and Spa
